name: live-v1
description: Controlled live scenarios for comparing native / inbot / edge execution. Kept deliberately small: these are expensive enough that 7 is the honest budget.

scenarios.title: Exact repeat of a deterministic task
scenarios.intent: deterministic arithmetic that should be answered without GrokBot
scenarios.goal: Calculate 1234+5678 and return the integer result

scenarios.title: Safe semantic paraphrase of an already-answered task
scenarios.goal: Compute 1234 plus 5678 and return the integer result

scenarios.title: Long context, small answer
scenarios.intent: answer one precise question from a large body of text
scenarios.goal: In the repository root README, how many deterministic benchmark fixtures are listed? Return only the number.

scenarios.title: Repository analysis, read-only
scenarios.intent: understand the repository without changing it
scenarios.goal: Read this repository and report which cache layer is consulted first and why. Do not modify any files.

scenarios.title: Repository modification on a disposable fixture
scenarios.intent: make a change that must not leak into other modes
scenarios.goal: In this repository, add a line to the file fixtures/TASK_NOTE.md recording that this fixture was modified. Do not touch anything else.

scenarios.title: Current-events research (advisory route)
scenarios.intent: reasoning/research that should go to the advisory worker, not GrokBot
scenarios.goal: Compare the tradeoffs of storing benchmark state in SQLite versus JSON files for a local-first CLI. Recommend one and justify briefly.

scenarios.title: Authenticated browser interaction — the one that genuinely needs GrokBot
scenarios.intent: the only scenario in this suite that may legitimately require GrokBot
scenarios.goal: Open the public example test page at example.com and report the page title exactly.

notes: Six of seven scenarios are designed to be completable without GrokBot.
A scenario that fails is recorded as a failure and is never counted as a saving.
The browser scenario is expected to invoke GrokBot; that is the point of including it.
